scope: Research the best-performing speculative draft-head family for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-like hybrid MoE models and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and define the first QAT logit-distillation target. This is a decision record only: no draft-head training, QAT implementation, backend integration, or new performance claim was executed.

parent_probes: Read the pinned DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 config and tensor index.
Fetched only safetensors headers by HTTP range for the three DSpark shards; no model shard was downloaded.
Fetched and read the DSpark and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash papers, DeepSpec trainer/config sources, and acceptance-loss papers.
Launched three read-only workers for exact checkpoint architecture, external head landscape, and local DFlash2/QAT seams; independently checked their decisive claims against primary sources.

worker_reports.boundary: Worker reports are evidence; this file is the parent receipt.

deepseek_v41_flash_native_head.identity: The checkpoint names the family mtp.*, but the config and paper identify it as DSpark, not DeepSeek-V3-style joint MTP.

tensor_audit.families: Three DeepSeek-V4 blocks: stage 0 adds target-layer fusion main_proj/main_norm; stage 2 adds norm, rank-256 Markov embed/head, and scalar confidence projection; draft logits reuse the target LM head.
tensor_audit.header_probe: HTTP 206 Content-Range checks against pinned shards; only safetensors JSON headers and dtype/shape byte ranges were inspected.

paper_claims.architecture: Parallel block backbone plus lightweight sequential Markov head, confidence head, and hardware-aware prefix scheduler.
paper_claims.offline: Across Qwen3-4B/8B/14B, DSpark improved macro accepted length over EAGLE-3 by 30.9/26.7/30.0 percent and over DFlash by 16.3/18.4/18.3 percent.
paper_claims.production: Compared with MTP-1 in DeepSeek-V4 Flash serving, DSpark improved per-user generation speed by 60 to 85 percent at matched throughput.
paper_claims.training: Frozen target; frozen shared embedding/LM head; update drafter, sequential head, and confidence head; anchor-bounded block packing.

local_dflash2_state.prior_selector_distillation: Seven exact-parity selector candidates failed live acceptance; control 66.683 percent, best candidate 66.406 percent. Proxy improvement did not transfer.
local_dflash2_state.tooling_boundary: The existing MXFP4 GPTQ path is post-training quantization, not QAT. No trainable fake-quant or straight-through path exists in the local DFlash2/GPTQ stack.

ranking.name: Native one-layer Qwen4Exp MTP for immediate Strata QAT
ranking.why: It is already implemented, uses the target tokenizer/LM head and per-stream Qwen hidden contract, and the B550 Q2_0 runtime accepted 69-71 of 71-72 offered drafts on the short coding probe. It is the only head that can be distilled and live-gated without a new backend.
ranking.position: Train this first as the production QAT lane.

ranking.name: DSpark-style DFlash2 for the next high-upside head
ranking.why: DSpark directly addresses DFlash suffix decay with a rank-256 Markov head and adds calibrated confidence scheduling. In matched open experiments it beat DFlash accepted length by 16-18 percent and EAGLE-3 by 27-31 percent.
ranking.position: Extend the promoted DFlash2 G3 full head with DSpark Markov and confidence heads; do not spend the next campaign on selector-only distillation.

ranking.name: Official DeepSeek V4.1 DSpark
ranking.why: It is the exact native head for that checkpoint and has the strongest production-system evidence, but it is not weight-compatible with Qwen Flash Next and requires a new Strata proposal loop and FP8/MXFP4 backend.
ranking.position: Use its architecture/training recipe for DeepSeek work; port the design, not tensors, to Qwen.

not_recommended: Medusa-style independent heads: superseded by DSpark/DFlash/EAGLE-3 evidence.
Deeper native Qwen MTP chains before QAT: available community evidence favors depth 1-2 for this architecture.
Pure selector-only DFlash2 distillation: already failed live acceptance despite exact parity.
Token trees as a rewrite: keep chain verification default and cost-gate any width extension because MoE verification amplifies routed-expert work.

qat_logit_distillation_plan.phase_0: Prove exact native-forward, cache rollback, tokenizer, hidden-state extraction, and target parity for the chosen head. A Flash-Next target adapter is still missing for DFlash2.
qat_logit_distillation_plan.phase_1: Capture anchor-bounded blocks from the exact calibrated production teacher. Store target pre-LM-head hidden states plus enough logits or top-k mass to reproduce the loss exactly; do not silently treat top-k CE as full-vocabulary TV.

phase_2_objectives.native_qwen: Use acceptance-directed EAL/LK losses first, with ordinary KL and DSpark-style 0.1 CE + 0.9 TV controls. Greedy serving favors EAL; sampled serving requires WTV/temperature-scaled overlap.
phase_2_objectives.dspark_dflash2: Use the DeepSpec DSpark recipe: position decay gamma 4, CE weight 0.1, TV/L1 weight 0.9, confidence BCE weight 1.0; train Markov and confidence heads with the frozen target. Compare against LK/EAL before selecting one.
phase_2_objectives.on_policy: Add Draft-OPD-style replay from verification-exposed error states only after the supervised objective; offline prefix accuracy remains a proxy.

phase_3_quantization.first: Select a BF16 candidate by live acceptance, then apply PTQ/Q2_0-style deployment quantization and repeat every gate. The current MXFP4 path is GPTQ/PTQ, not QAT.
phase_3_quantization.true_qat: Implement fake-quant plus straight-through training only if PTQ loses exact parity or paired live acceptance. Floor target-hidden fusion, norms, and input projections at high precision; aggressive 2-bit quantization belongs first to drafter experts.
phase_3_quantization.boundary: Keep the trunk block feeding the drafter high enough precision that hidden-state argmax drift does not destroy acceptance.

promotion_gate: full paired corpus against pinned incumbent
